edits.old: SERVER-127943 reports that resuming a multikey wildcard build at the beginning of bulk load could crash a secondary with WT_DUPLICATE_KEY. Missing restoration of the metadata-key deduplication flag caused duplicate container inserts. The ticket lists a fix in 9.0.0-rc0; it does not confirm all requested backports. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
edits.new: SERVER-127943 reports that resuming an index build does not set BulkBuilderImpl::_hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys, so for a wildcard index the build may incorrectly try to insert a multikey metadata key twice. The ticket lists a fix in 9.0.0-rc0 and a backport request for v8.3, v8.0 and v7.0; it does not confirm the backports. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943

edits.old: Resume state records the build phase and per-index sorter ranges and table identifiers. Step-up attempts recovery from that state; if recovery fails, the build aborts. Resumability therefore does not guarantee every interrupted build completes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)
edits.new: If a primary-driven index build cannot be resumed, the server logs a failure and aborts it instead, so resumability does not guarantee every interrupted build completes. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/index_builds_coordinator.cpp

edits.old: The development implementation supports resume after failover or primary restart. An October 2026 ticket explicitly identifies lingering test exclusions claiming non-resumability as stale. This does not establish availability in any deployed release. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-16)
edits.new: In the development branch, primary-driven index builds (PDIB) are resumable, including across failover (stepdown/step-up); resumability work for failover was fixed in 9.0.0-rc0. An October 2026 ticket (SERVER-136189) states that PDIB are resumable and that about 10 tests still carry stale exclusions saying they are not. This does not establish availability in any deployed release. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-136189 ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-125827
